symptom: Machine does not drain or drains slowly The washing machine does not drain or drains slowly and displays E1.
failure_mode: Drain hose blocked The drain hose is blocked.
corrective_action: Remove the blockage Remove the drain blockage and push Start/Pause once. Remove the blockage. Push the Start/Pause button once.

symptom: Display shows E4 The washing machine display shows E4.
failure_mode: Water inlet valve blocked The water inlet valve is blocked.
corrective_action: Clean the water inlet valve Clean the water inlet valve and restart operation. Clean the water inlet valve. Push the Start/Pause button once.

symptom: No draining The washer does not drain during rinse or spin.
failure_mode: Drain motor does not act when voltage exists The drain motor does not act even though voltage exists at its terminals.
failure_mode_name: Drain motor does not act when voltage exists
corrective_action: Replace the drain motor Replace the drain motor. Replace the drain motor.

symptom: Keep filling water Water continues filling when it should not.
failure_mode: Water can fill into the water inlet valve without power Water enters the water inlet valve with power off.
failure_mode_name: Water can fill into the water inlet valve without power
corrective_action: Replace the water inlet valve Replace the water inlet valve. Replace the water inlet valve.
